wholePhysicalScope: Named scheduled site, twenty current mapped wall traces, and the separately mapped polygon of the standing conservation shelter. The visible pavement follows the excavated Orphic room at the far north end of the villa.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the surviving villa walls, timber conservation cover and low mosaic room.
limitations: The model depicts excavated remains and the current shelter. Wall courses, individual stone shapes, short unmapped edge sections, deck levels, rail details and shingle tones are approximate.
The triconch room uses the reported scale with a simplified geometric representation of the pavement field. Fine animal and human figures and the missing or repaired tesserae are outside the model.
The surviving site is modeled at the original grade. The exterior does not recreate buried walls, a Roman-era superstructure or the separately addressed Littlecote House.
